item.title: Obituary - Brittany Hawkins
item.description: Brittany Hawkins, age 36, of Clinton, Missouri passed away on Saturday, January 24, 2026 at St. Luke's Plaza in Kansas City, Missouri. There are no services at this time. Memorial contributions can be made to Brittnay's Memorial Fund and may be left in care of the funeral home.Arrangements have been entrusted to Vansant-Mills Funeral Home in Clinton, Missouri.

item.title: Some interesting statistics from the MU Extension
item.description: In 2023, most Missouri businesses with employees (76%) and nonemployer firms (58%) were operated by men. However, women continue to play a powerful and growing role in the state’s economy. Women-owned businesses made up over half (51%) of all service-sector firms in Missouri.One of Missouri’s fastest growing job sectors, health care, is led overwhelmingly by women.
